# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v1.2.0

这一版本让未完成工作的结构和依赖更容易看懂，也把开会日、Checklist 结果和执行切片的实际操作补充完整。

## 主要更新

- 新增“未完成工作关系图”：自动展开到长期领域，同时显示上下层、“完成后开始”和“需先行”关系；支持搜索、筛选、缩放、拖动画布、关联高亮以及从右侧栏进入工作项详情。
- 新增“开会日”，覆盖 conference、talk 和合作会议。会议结束前不预设自由时间，会后可选择是否安排个人事务，当日不记录营养摄入。
- 每日 Checklist 现在支持待处理、已完成、部分完成和未完成四种结果；部分完成按半项折算，同时保留旧版勾选数据。
- 层级浏览只为今天仍有未完成切片的事务显示蓝色“今日”标签，并新增“未设切片／待安排／已安排／切片完成”进度提示；进行中和重点投入分别使用绿色和红色。
- 事务日历右键可根据日期执行“提前完成”“完成”或“补记完成”。提前完成会保留原计划日期，并在本周视图的实际完成日留下单独的成就记录。
- 手表睡眠评分和晨起体重可以先选择当天是否具备记录条件；没有佩戴手表或没有体重计时，不再被当作漏填。
- 依赖下拉菜单只显示进行中和待开始的候选事务，减少长列表干扰。

## 修复与体验改进

- 修复关系图空白、依赖箭头重叠、方向不明确和状态标签样式不一致的问题。
- 修复本周提前完成无响应或让原计划卡片消失的问题，并改善同一天存在多个历史切片时的日历数量显示。
- 优化关系图卡片间距、点击空白取消高亮、右侧详情字号，以及科研工作日今日安排的条件输入布局。

## 升级说明

现有工作项、切片、生活节律、Checklist 和营养数据均兼容，无需手动迁移。旧版 Checklist 勾选会继续作为“已完成”读取，已有切片的计划日期不会被改写。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v1.2.0

This release makes unfinished work and its dependencies easier to understand while completing the real-world workflows for conference days, Checklist outcomes, and execution slices.

## Highlights

- Added an Unfinished Work Relationship Graph with long-term-area context, hierarchy links, hard prerequisites, and should-stay-ahead relationships. It supports search, filters, zoom, canvas panning, related-node highlighting, and opening item details from the inspector.
- Added Conference Day for conferences, talks, and collaborative meetings. It assumes no free time before the event ends, lets personal tasks remain optional afterward, and skips nutrition logging for that day.
- Daily Checklist now supports Pending, Completed, Partial, and Missed outcomes. Partial completion contributes half credit, and legacy checks remain compatible.
- Hierarchy browsing now shows a blue Today badge only on Transactions with unfinished slices today, plus Not configured / To schedule / Scheduled / Completed slice indicators. In Progress and Focused use green and red.
- Transaction calendars expose Complete Early, Complete, or Correct as Completed from the context menu according to the slice date. Early completion keeps the planned date and adds a separate achievement on the actual completion date in Week.
- Watch Sleep Score and Morning Weight now begin with an availability decision, so missing a watch or scale is not treated as missing data.
- Dependency pickers now show only Ready and In Progress transaction candidates, keeping the menus focused.

## Fixes and refinements

- Fixed blank relationship canvases, overlapping dependency arrows, ambiguous edge direction, and inconsistent status-pill styling.
- Fixed Complete Early doing nothing or removing the original planned card, and clarified calendar counts when legacy data contains multiple slices on one date.
- Improved graph spacing, blank-canvas highlight clearing, inspector typography, and conditional Research Workday layout.

## Upgrade notes

Existing work items, slices, Life Rhythm records, Checklist state, and nutrition data remain compatible with no manual migration. Legacy Checklist checks remain Completed, and existing planned slice dates are not rewritten.

## Download

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated source-code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.

See [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.en.md) for the complete record.
